title: Seedling: a seed-grown, reproducible literature-review pipeline
description: Modular, multi-stage pipeline that grows a reviewed corpus from a small set of seed papers, combining BERTopic clustering, deterministic Scopus and arXiv retrieval, a researcher-weighted hybrid relevance scorer over seven explicit signals, coverage-probe recall and BERTopic membership verification, and an optional frozen, manifest-tracked snapshot for exact reproduction.
